notes: Each account now shows under the right bank: the bank is read from the SMS sender and its sign-off, not from a payee or the other person's bank
No more phantom banks: receiving money from someone at another bank won't create an account you don't have
Two different banks that share the last 4 digits (e.g. a Kotak and an HDFC account) stay separate
Co-operative and small banks like Vasai Vikas (VVSB) and more Kotak senders are now recognised
GPay, PhonePe and BHIM payments now sit under your real bank account instead of a separate "Google Pay UPI" style account
Balance replies count: "your account balance is ₹X" from the bank updates that account, and balances carry forward through newer spends
Choosing banks is fixed: the list scrolls and the Save button is always visible
